Please accept our apologies if this was how the interaction came across.
We recognise how important it is for patients to feel welcomed into the practice.  Our reception team work in a demanding environment, and regularly deal with challenging situations, however this should never be at the expense of making patients feel undervalued or indeed unwelcome.
We appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention and will take your comments seriously. Your feedback will be shared with the team so we can reflect and continue to improve the service we provide.
